title: Mera sab ghar ujad gaya bhai
body:
Aake zainab ne di sada bhai
Mera sab ghar ujad gaya bhai
Uth'ke dekho to qabre at'har se
Mera kya haal ho gaya bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pusht zaqmi kamar qameedah hai
taik ke chalti hu'n asaa bhai
lad khadaati hu'n chal nahi sakti
Uth ke do mujh ko aasra bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek sajjade naatawaa'n ke siwa
koi baaqi nahi bacha bhai
Khoke aayi hu'n mai sakina ko
jaa'n gaza hai ye waaqeya bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Arbaee'n dhoom se manaane ka
Dil me armaan reh gaya bhai
Ahle yasrab ka kis tarah bolo
Kar sakoongi mai saamna bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa rahi hu'n watan khuda haafiz
Muntazar hongi fatima bhai
Maa ku turbat pa jaake ro'ungi
Rone se jee nahi bhara bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pooche tumko jo fatima soughra
Us ko bolo kahu'n mai kya bhai
